prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Empire narrative character master C01-CHAR-NOBANNER-02, a genuinely transparent reusable RGBA image, square canvas.
Primary request: Redraw No-Banner in its later negotiated COORDINATOR stage, still a plural memory collective. Image1 is the original coordinator card, authority for the grouped hooded shape, six ordinary human faces and open palms, NOT authority for parchment texture or identical closed eyes. Image2 is the newly drawn unstable-stage No-Banner: authority for clean cartoon rendering, navy/slate/tan cloth palette, separate identity tags and ordinary-human faces. Image3 is the approved formation scene, human memory continuity only, no environment.
Story: many different deceased people temporarily agree to coordinate, keep their separate wishes and may leave; no king, master, commander or natural single soul. A calm shared rhythm is negotiated, not universal submission. The novel describes both ordinary soldiers and an apron-wearing camp cook among voices; later passages explicitly reject a king of the dead.
Subject and pose: One broad composite cluster, softly gathered dark slate-gray/blue cowl folds with SIX independently identifiable ordinary adult human faces arranged in an open, loose vertically tiered group. Preserve a dark-haired hooded adult near top, two differently bearded adults, an older gray-bearded man, a youthful short-haired adult and an adult camp-cook woman wearing a simple cloth headwrap, all clearly different individuals, no child. Faces similar scale; the upper face is no more than 15 percent larger than the others, not an enthroned master. Expressions differ: one listens with eyes closed, one looks gently sideways, one is mid-sentence, one is reserved, two attentive. Never all identical eyes, mouths or emotional agreement. Keep several subtle transparent separations between the remembered figures so they are clearly individuals, not severed heads growing from a person's chest. The headwrapping and folds frame each voice individually.
Two calm open human palms extend sideways, each emerging from its own visible cloth fold, suggesting room to choose, no magic orb, spellcasting, weapon or commanding gesture. Six individual small warm wood/metal name tags remain distinct on short cords, unlettered, no royal/religious emblems. Bottom divides into several gently diverging folded cloth memory tails with open gaps and a clear way to separate, no feet or ground and no sealed massive robe pedestal.
Framing: full broad nearly square aggregate with generous transparent margins; every hood, face, open hand, tag and tail fully inside, all edges and extremities intact. Fill about 84-88 percent canvas area with the complete silhouette, not a tall individual human portrait. Large readable face masses for a 192x224 card.
Style: polished approachable cartoon fantasy, broad quiet matte planes, strong chunky near-black clean outlines, simplified two-to-three tone face and cloth shading, crisp shapes, natural human skin colors subtly quieter than living people, cool slate with muted tan edging. Smooth graphic color blocks, no fine scratches, grain, speckling, hatching or aged-paper texture.
Alpha: genuine transparent exterior, no painted background. Faces, palms, tags and major cloth planes near-opaque; some connecting memory cloth and lower trailing folds deliberately partially transparent as image-authored alpha. Keep readable over white and black. All outermost pixels transparent. No glowing halo, mist background, floor, shadow oval, border, UI or text.
Avoid: single ordinary ghost, skeleton king, giant central torso, skulls, injuries, blood, horror, ritual idol, crown, giant dominant face, uniform synchronized expressions, complete flags, banner poles, weapons, badges of ownership, readable text, scenery, parchment, checkerboard, photorealism. Clear phase difference from unstable01: fewer flying fragments, more space to listen, open palms, retained plural disagreement.
